title: Hardware-aware quantum attention for fast radio burst identification
summary: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration extragalactic pulses whose discovery requires searches over large signal-parameter spaces and the rejection of candidate sets dominated by radio-frequency interference and noise. Integrating quantum processors into FRB searches requires a workflow connecting telescop data to hardware-compatible models. Here we develop a pipeline that converts raw search-mode PSRFITS data into dynamic-spectrum segments and identifies FRB-like signals using a hybrid Quantum Vision Transformer (QViT).
